title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: premium uplift by the goods category of a cover
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line selects the uplift percent applied to the premium of a bound cover, according to the cover's Cargo Type.

## Rule

The uplift percent is chosen by the cover's Cargo Type:

| Cover's Cargo Type | Uplift percent applied |
|---|---|
| Dangerous goods | The product's dangerous goods uplift |
| Reefer | The product's reefer uplift |
| Out of gauge | The product's out-of-gauge uplift |
| General | None |

The uplift increases the base premium.

## Hypothetical case

A bound cover of Cargo Type reefer under a product whose reefer uplift is taken, for illustration only, as 12 percent: a base premium of 500.00 is increased by 12 percent, to 560.00. The same cover of Cargo Type general would carry no uplift and stay at 500.00.

## Points of judgement

**The goods are refrigerated, but the cover records the Cargo Type as general. Which uplift applies?** The uplift follows the cover's Cargo Type as recorded, so none applies.
